d:
Some meals are more than just recipes. They're comfort, nostalgia, and the feeling of home.
If you've had to give up dishes you love because of lactose or gluten, this one's for you. In this video, we're bringing back the joy of a rich, creamy butter chicken, paired with soft, gluten-free naan, so you don't have to miss out on the flavors you grew up loving.
Made with simple ingredients and plenty of heart, this recipe proves that dietary restrictions don't mean compromising on taste.
Ingredients
Butter Chicken
Chicken Marinade
• 1 kg bone-in (or 650 g boneless) chicken
• Juice of 1 lemon
